purpose: Measured OSM-to-satellite registration input. Do not populate from screenshots by inference.

recommended_features: other stable, visually identifiable course feature
requirements.measurement_rule: Each point must be measured from the fixed raster against the corresponding OSM coordinate; no point may be inferred from a generated overlay.
requirements.distribution_rule: Spread points across the course footprint rather than clustering them in one area.
requirements.validation_rule: Keep independent check points separate from fit points where possible.

point_schema.feature_ref: OSM way/node id or greens dataset reference
